problems: Missing external textures produced magenta/black beauty shading instead of a neutral surface read.
A loose accessory strap dominated auto-framing and reduced the camera body to a small fraction of each view.
decision: Preserve the failed images, apply a neutral clay material inside the isolated reference renderer, and explicitly exclude the loose strap accessory while retaining the camera body and attached lugs.
evidence_boundary: This renderer repair occurs after seeing the failed source render and therefore is not credited as held-out modeling capability.
